strings.categories.9.practical.exercises.8: Driving through an uncontrolled level crossing
strings.categories.9.practical.notes.0: The exercise zones of the first stage for categories B, B1, C, C1, D, D1 are listed in para. 38 of the Examination Rules. The order and set of exercises at a particular test ground are set by its layout: the method on 24pdd.kz for Almaty marks some of the zones as “removed”.
strings.categories.9.practical.notes.1: Para. 40 of the Examination Rules specifies a bus with “not more than 28 seats” for D1, although under the Act only buses with up to 16 seats in addition to the driver’s seat belong to D1; for D it says “not less than 28 seats”. This looks like an inaccuracy in the Rules, so check with the specialised PSC.
strings.categories.9.practical.notes.2: The requirement of 1 year of experience on C1 for D1 is unusual, but that is what the current text says (PRG, version of 25.08.2026; the same on kodeksy-kz and the kazpdd blog). Tengrinews (June 2026) mentions only 3 years of experience.
strings.categories.9.practical.notes.3: A category D licence confirms the right to D1 as well (Road Traffic Act, art. 73(8)).

strings.categories.10.name: Category D: buses
strings.categories.10.vehicles: Motor cars for the carriage of passengers with more than 8 seats in addition to the driver’s seat; such cars with a trailer of up to 750 kg ⟦69⟧.
strings.categories.10.age: 23 years (art. 74(2), as amended by the Law of 18.07.2024 No. 126-VIII)
strings.categories.10.experience: At least 3 years of experience as a driver, including at least 1 year of driving vehicles of subcategory D1 (art. 74(2))
strings.categories.10.theory: General theory test at a specialised PSC (Public Service Centre): 40 questions, 40 minutes, at least 32 correct answers required, language - Kazakh, Russian or English ⟦70⟧. If you are opening several categories at once, you take the theory test only once ⟦71⟧. Whether the set of questions differs by category is not officially confirmed (see notes).
strings.categories.10.practical.where: Automated test ground of the State Corporation “Government for Citizens” (specialised PSC), assessed by an automatic system ⟦72⟧. Theory first, then the practical test ⟦73⟧.
strings.categories.10.practical.vehicle: Bus with not less than 28 seats and a length of not less than 7.0 m ⟦74⟧

strings.categories.11.name: Subcategory D1E: minibus with a heavy trailer
strings.categories.11.vehicles: A subcategory D1 motor car with a trailer that is not designed for the carriage of passengers and whose maximum authorised mass is more than 750 kg but not more than the unladen mass of the car, with a total maximum authorised mass of the combination of not more than 12 000 kg ⟦75⟧.
strings.categories.11.age: Not set separately: you need to have held the right to D or D1 for at least 12 months, so usually not before 22
strings.categories.11.experience: At least 12 months of holding the right to drive vehicles of category D or subcategory D1 (art. 74(2))
strings.categories.11.theory: General theory test at a specialised PSC (Public Service Centre): 40 questions, 40 minutes, at least 32 correct answers required, language - Kazakh, Russian or English ⟦76⟧. If you are opening several categories at once, you take the theory test only once ⟦77⟧. Whether the set of questions differs by category is not officially confirmed (see notes).
strings.categories.11.practical.where: Automated test ground of the State Corporation “Government for Citizens” (specialised PSC), assessed by an automatic system ⟦78⟧. Theory first, then the practical test ⟦79⟧.
strings.categories.11.practical.exercises.1: Exercises for combinations follow the test ground layout (the list is not published in the Examination Rules)
strings.categories.11.practical.notes.0: For BE, CE, C1E, DE and D1E, para. 39 of the Examination Rules describes only the zone markings: control lines 1.4, yellow broken lines marking the start and end of exercises (width 0.10 m, dash 0.15 m, gap 0.10 m), white “Start” and “Finish” lines 0.4 m wide, lettering 1 m from the lines.
strings.categories.11.practical.notes.1: The practical test is taken on a vehicle of the category for which the licence is issued ⟦81⟧, and separately from the base category ⟦82⟧. We did not find a list of exercises and penalties for combinations in open sources: ask for the layout at the specialised PSC or the training organisation.
strings.categories.11.practical.notes.2: A category DE licence confirms the right to D1E as well (Road Traffic Act, art. 73(8)).
